batch.retryManyConfirm: This will wake {{count}} request(s) while still respecting concurrency and recovery spacing.

history.title: Request history
history.description: Redacted metadata is returned with server-side pagination
history.eventsEmpty: No operational events in this process

timeline.label: Request timeline
timeline.truncated: This request timeline was long; {{count}} earlier intermediate events were omitted. The first and latest events are retained.

errorDetail.title: Upstream error detail
errorDetail.structured: The upstream returned a structured error
errorDetail.unparsed: The upstream returned an error response that could not be parsed safely

retryPolicy.title: Retry policy
retryPolicy.honorRetryAfter: Honor upstream Retry-After (may only extend the wait)
retryPolicy.retryWaitingNow: Wake waiting requests immediately after applying
retryPolicy.immediateWarning: Immediate mode still respects global recovery spacing, but it requires a maximum additional-attempt limit.
retryPolicy.globalSpacing: Every policy still respects global concurrency, queue, and recovery-spacing limits.
retryPolicy.retryUnavailable: The current state cannot retry now
retryPolicy.noEligible: No requests can receive a retry policy
retryPolicy.quickConfirmDescription: Apply “{{preset}}” to {{count}} request(s). Requests already in flight will use it after their next failure.
retryPolicy.confirmDescription: Apply this policy to {{count}} request(s), with up to {{estimate}} additional calls. Confirm the volume and side effects are acceptable.

validation.duration: Duration must be between 5 seconds and 24 hours
validation.interval: The interval must be valid and shorter than the duration
validation.attempts: Additional attempts are outside the allowed range

uncertain.title: Resolve uncertain delivery
uncertain.description: The upstream may have received this request, but the relay did not receive a definitive response. Choose an operator decision, inspect the safe evidence, then record a reason.
uncertain.previewWarning: The evidence is read-only. No upstream call is made during preview.
uncertain.confirmNote: This decision is recorded in the request timeline and cannot be undone from this console.
uncertain.reasonPlaceholder: Record the evidence or approval that supports this decision
uncertain.reasonRequired: Enter a reason before resolving this delivery
uncertain.hashNotice: Only the idempotency-key hash is shown; the raw key is never displayed.
uncertain.noAttemptEvidence: No attempt evidence was retained for this request.
uncertain.readOnlyDescription: Viewer sessions can inspect request timelines but cannot preview or resolve uncertain delivery.

confirm_success.label: Confirm success
confirm_success.description: The upstream processed the request successfully; do not send it again.

abandon.label: Abandon delivery
abandon.description: Stop tracking this attempt without claiming that the upstream succeeded.

request_compensation.label: Request compensation
request_compensation.description: Approve a controlled compensation/recovery path for this uncertain attempt.

repeat.title: Create continuous task
repeat.retryDescription: Retry only after failure, stopping on the first success or when the deadline is reached.
repeat.repeatDescription: The original request returns normally while a background task continues after both success and failure.
repeat.regenerate: Generate a new key for every run
repeat.maxTokensHint: Uses only the upstream usage.total_tokens; the task pauses when usage is missing and never estimates.
repeat.warning: Continuous execution can repeatedly incur model cost or business side effects. Credentials remain in this process only and tasks do not resume after restart. Token budgets use authoritative upstream usage only; no cost estimate is calculated.
repeat.confirmDescription: This action can repeatedly call the upstream and incur cost. Confirm that the interval, duration, and idempotency policy are intentional.
repeat.tasksDescription: Safe summaries are retained; authentication remains only in the current process.
repeat.noActive: No continuous tasks are currently active
repeat.memoryOnly: Running or paused tasks are marked interrupted after a service restart and are never sent automatically.
